title: Partnering with you to build a more sustainable tomorrow.
subtitle: Evergreen Wireless is committed to our environment, providing businesses with eco-positive, sustainable, products and services.
intro_paragraph: As an industry-leading provider of Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) smartphones and complementary Buy Back programs for enterprise clients, Evergreen Wireless assists businesses in reducing e-waste, optimizing device lifecycles, and managing mobile device investments. Our comprehensive portfolio of products and services delivers turnkey mobile device solutions that drive a measurable environmental benefit.
buyback_desc: Receive a high value trade-in credit for used devices, regardless of their condition, maximizing the device investment and minimizing the environmental impact.
cpo_desc: Our Grade A certified devices are in like-new condition, backed by a 2-Year warranty and include a protective case, screen protector, charger and cable – packaged in a biodegradable box.
new_devices_desc: Through strategic partnerships with select manufacturers, Evergreen Wireless offers exceptional value on mobile phones, tablets, mobile hotspots, wireless home phone, wireless broadband solutions, smart home IOT and streaming set-top boxes.
custom_kitting_desc: From tailored kitting to end-to-end MDM setup and oversight, Evergreen Wireless delivers turnkey staging and deployment solutions that streamline operations and accelerate readiness.
connected_bundles_desc: Two prepaid retail-ready bundles are available. Get a new 6.6" LTE smartphone with either a pre-activated 30-day plan, or a ready-to-activate plan of your choice.
leasing_desc: A flexible solution for organizations with a dynamic workforce. Lease CPO devices for up to 6-month terms for as little as $50.00 per month. Simple, predictable and cost-effective.
warranty_desc: With Evergreen ExtendedCare+, your device warranty term extends to match your carrier plan—delivering uninterrupted coverage and peace of mind for the entire contract duration.
bridge_partnership: Evergreen Wireless is part of the Bridge Wireless family, a strategic partnership rooted in innovation and backed by industry certifications for reliability and trust.
